      <title>Uptalent.io: Paid Ads Marketing Expert (Fully Remote, Full-Time, Part-Time)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country />
      <state />
      <skills>Paid Social Media Advertising, Retargeting, Social Media Marketing, Bug Tracking, Social Media Management, Social Media Ads, KPI Tracking, Social Media Content, Inventory Tracking, and Display Advertising</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Dominican Republic
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://uptalent.io">http://uptalent.io</a>
</p>

<strong>Description</strong><br><p>Uptalent is a dynamic platform connecting businesses with highly-skilled remote professionals. Our mission is to empower companies and professionals to thrive in the remote work landscape.</p><p></p><p>We are expanding our network and seeking Paid Ads Marketing Experts to join Uptalent's network. As a Paid Ads Marketing Expert, you will be a crucial part of supporting our clients, driving successful digital marketing campaigns through paid advertising channels. This fully remote position requires a proactive and results-driven individual who excels in managing paid media strategies.</p><p></p><p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p><ol><li><strong>Campaign Management:</strong></li></ol><ul> <li>Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across various platforms.</li> <li>Monitor and analyze campaign performance, adjusting strategies to maximize ROI.</li> </ul><li><strong>Client Communication:</strong></li><ul> <li>Collaborate with clients to understand their business goals and develop tailored paid media strategies.</li> <li>Provide regular updates and reports on campaign performance.</li> </ul><li><strong>Ad Copy and Creative Development:</strong></li><ul> <li>Create compelling ad copy and visuals that align with client branding and goals.</li> <li>Conduct A/B testing to refine ad creatives and improve campaign performance.</li> </ul><li><strong>Budget Management:</strong></li><ul> <li>Set, manage, and optimize advertising budgets to achieve client objectives.</li> <li>Identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiency improvements.</li> </ul><li><strong>Data Analysis:</strong></li><ul> <li>Utilize analytics tools to extract actionable insights and recommend optimizations.</li> <li>Stay updated on industry trends and emerging paid media platforms.</li> </ul><br><br><strong>Requirements</strong><br><ol> <li>Proven experience as a Paid Ads Marketing Expert or in a relevant digital marketing role.</li> <li>In-depth knowledge of advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and others.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make strategic recommendations.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.</li> <li>Results-driven mindset with a focus on achieving client objectives.</li> </ol><p></p><p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p><ol> <li>Google Ads and Facebook Blueprint certifications.</li> <li>Experience with e-commerce or B2B marketing.</li> <li>Familiarity with additional paid media channels beyond the major platforms.</li> </ol><p></p><p><strong>How to Apply:</strong> Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience as a Paid Ads Marketing Expert.</p><br><br><strong>Benefits</strong><br><ul> <li>Work for the most exciting companies in the North American Market.</li> <li>Flexible schedules.</li> <li>Work from anywhere.</li> <li>Highly competitive compensation.</li> </ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/uptalent-io-paid-ads-marketing-expert-fully-remote-full-time-part-time">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/uptalent-io-paid-ads-marketing-expert-fully-remote-full-time-part-time</a></p>
</description>
